firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Sharing our open-source benchmark, agent skill, reproduction notebook, and frozen experimental artifacts for our Paper Track submission (**StateBridge × TwinAPI: Resolving the Stateful False-Friend Paradox in Cross-Library Code Migration with Gemma 4**) in accordance with Competition Rule 3.6.b:

- **Kaggle Public Reproduction Notebook**: https://www.kaggle.com/code/philiplinhan/statebridge-reproduction-gemma-4-paper-track
- **Public Apache-2.0 Source Repository on GitHub**: `GGGODLIN/gemma4-state-bridge` (full code, frozen LLM generations, 3-page paper PDF, and interactive HTML wire-trace explorer; also attached below)

### What's Inside
1. **`TwinAPI` Audit (`artifacts/twinapi_audit.json`)**: 15 core `requests==2.34.2` ↔ `httpx==0.28.1` API pairs (12 stateful false friends across 5 divergence families `F1..F5` + 3 true equivalents) with 256-d `gemini-embedding-001` cosine similarity (`0.873` mean across false friends).
2. **`StateBridge-Bench` & Loopback HTTP State-Machine Harness (`skills/state-bridge/scripts/statebridge_core.py`)**: 30 multi-file workflows (`5` families × `6` parameterized variants) evaluated against ephemeral `127.0.0.1:0` `ThreadingHTTPServer` instances with canonical wire-trace equivalence and `P1..P4` PBT invariants.
3. **270 Frozen Live Runs (`artifacts/runs.jsonl`, `artifacts/raw_llm_generations.jsonl`)**: 5-arm ablation across `Gemma-4-31B-IT` (`13.3%` → `90.0%`, exact two-sided McNemar $p = 2.38 \times 10^{-7}$) and `Gemma-4-26B-A4B-IT` (`13.3%` → `96.7%`, $p = 5.96 \times 10^{-8}$), reproducible locally without API keys via `python3 scripts/build_ssot.py --verify-replay`.
